component.name: FinderMaxxing
component.summary: Fast file manager for local files, servers and cloud storage

description.p: FinderMaxxing browses huge folders smoothly, previews files, searches by name and contents, and works the same way on S3, SFTP, SMB, WebDAV, Google Drive, Dropbox and OneDrive.
The free edition covers local browsing, file operations, previews and search. Pro adds remote storage, AI search, organization suggestions and the utilities.
